Active 12 V/15 ohm branch settles at 10.980 V/68.010 mA; Tungsram M31-120's 11 V/68 mA gives 161.765 ohm hot. Bounds are a declared +/-20% class sensitivity around that manufacturer comparator, not a B31G22 limit. Thermal transfer and emission remain unqualified.

M31-120 11 V/68 mA hot point gives 161.765 ohm. NASA pure-tungsten 300 K to 1000/1200/1400 K resistivity ratios 4.62/5.75/6.91 imply 35.0/28.1/23.4 ohm cold; 23..35 ohm is a rounded class range. The thermal model's 1192 K nominal heater is unmeasured, and B31G22 material/temperature may differ.

Linear slope (rho(T)/rho(300 K)-1)/(T-300 K) from NASA pure tungsten at 1000/1200/1400 K is 0.00518/0.00528/0.00537 1/K; model uses rounded 0.0053 with a wider 0.0051..0.0055 class range. Not an installed B31G22 filament specification.

Tungsram M31-120 at G2=250 V and grid-control cut-off 35..69 V implies effective mu=3.62..7.14 for the active G1/G2 law. With provisional isolated neck rails G1=-25 V/G2=350 V, Robotron's approximate cathode 35 V dark/15 V bright require mu>=5.25 and mu<8.375; overlap is 5.25..7.14. The 6.5 nominal lies inside. Bounds 3.5..30 retain exploratory B31G22/G4 uncertainty, not manufacturer limits; exact gun, connected rails and emission remain unqualified.

rejected_comparators.reason: The current 12 V ideal rail plus printed 15 ohm R22 cannot deliver the B30G1 6.3 V / 0.47 A point: it requires 13.35 V upstream. The active nominal electrothermal heater is also far from that point. The B30G1 gun is not the installed B31G22, so its data cannot supply an A6 bound or justify retuning the model.

open_families.reason: the heater hot point matches the Tungsram M31-120 comparator and its cold resistance/linear slope have conditional pure-tungsten bounds, but installed B31G22 material, thermal transfer, emission and electrode limits remain unqualified; the older RFT B30G1 comparator is incompatible with the 12 V/R22 branch

the page-16 measuring-cable inset has a series capacitor and shunt elements with no values; its dynamic transfer and digital-voltmeter loading are not bounded, so the 0.1/3.6 mV service readings cannot be scored against direct X3 DC voltage
T3 turns and parasitics still carry assumed-bound, not sourced class-typical or design-derived evidence

a cited Philips 31 cm/20 mm-neck family now bounds a class electrical/current proxy, but the active horizontal winding is outside that class and inner neck clearance, axial field length and sensitivity are not sourced to AE9VT
remaining assembly capacitance, leakage and control bounds lack per-value class sources

seventeen individual provisional semiconductor and IC models and six horizontal diode instances still have incomplete qualification or joint bounds; fourteen 1AE15 and two KFY18 instances have bounded family entries, while other frame-path devices remain uncovered

use_for_sensitivity: Only entries whose model_ref resolves to an active parameter and whose model response is validated may be swept as A6 class-typical bounds. Pending families are not qualified.
